description: Puts a person on the oqda waitlist (free and non-binding; oqda contacts them personally when a spot opens, then they decide). Only call this when the person asked for it, with their own e-mail address, and only after they explicitly agreed to this consent statement (German, show it to them): "Ihr dürft mich per E-Mail kontaktieren, sobald ein Platz auf der Warteliste frei wird." Never guess or invent an e-mail address. Calling again with the same e-mail has no further effect.

consent_confirmed.description: Must be true: the person explicitly agreed to the consent statement in this tool description.
